notes: All layers use identical canvas and coordinates; rotate about declared pivots, never image center.
Glass duplicates original opaque window pixels; keep body intact beneath it to ensure a fully opaque wipe.
Main blade is one blade; repeat around mast with foreshortening for the rotor disk.
Lights are OFF in art; render lighting in code.
4096-wide delivery; body source is 2062x763, resampled 1.7x, not native 4K.
Opaque wipe uses conservative inner rectangle; scale >= max(viewWidth/rect.width,viewHeight/rect.height) and center this rectangle on viewport before switching scenes.
